exact_statement: Let n>=3, p=2^-n, F any Boolean sign of Fourier support minimum Hamming distance at least3, and G any Boolean sign differing from F on exactly R vertices. For R>=1 every coordinate entropy decrement L_i is strictly less than [10R+(17/2)R^2]p. Every relevant coordinate is strictly paid at K_R=5R+(17/4)R^2, and at K=10R^2 the actual complete-child expected deficit exceeds the original deficit by more than (3/2)R^2p. For R0 the decrement is0. Therefore any least-essential-dimension positive fixed-K witness G, K>=0, cannot have R0 and must obey K<K_R for every such nearby seed, equivalently R>(2/17)(sqrt(25+17K)-5). No inherited fresh-bank claim or universal FEI theorem is made.
